label: Gateway Simulator
info: Simulates Edge Gateway A publishing Sparkplug B NBIRTH, DBIRTH, DDATA, and DDEATH lifecycle telemetry messages to Mosquitto MQTT broker. Read the on-canvas comment nodes for a walkthrough of how to onboard your own device, register a gateway, and approve a quarantined device -- see node_red_guide.md for the full write-up.

name: Guide on setting up a Gateway and Device
NBIRTH
info: The edge node's own birth certificate. Real Sparkplug B requires this once before any DBIRTH. This app's ingestion (process_node_message) treats NBIRTH/NDATA identically for gateway status, so it isn't strictly required here -- but real brokers/hosts expect the order below.

name: 1. Trigger NBIRTH Node Birth Certificate (once at startup)
Build NBIRTH Certificate (Virtual_Gateway_NodeRED)
ADD YOUR OWN DEVICE:
info: 1) Change the topic's last path segment to your device's name. 2) Change every Asset_ID metric value to match (must be identical in DBIRTH and DDATA below). 3) Replace the metric list with your device's real telemetry. 4) Deploy -- first DBIRTH auto-registers the device, no DB changes needed. See the comment near DBIRTH for what happens next.

name: COMPLETE THE LOOP -- Approve the device
info: On first DBIRTH, an unrecognized device is auto-inserted into the devices table as quarantined (is_quarantined = true) and its DDATA is silently dropped until approved. Open the app -> Devices tab -> 'Zero-Touch Onboarding Quarantine Queue' and Approve (or Reject) it as an Administrator or Shopfloor_Manager.

name: Build DBIRTH Certificate (Simulated_CNC_01)
Build DDATA Telemetry (Normal Ops)
Build DDEATH Death Certificate
Publish Overheat Spike (95°C)
Reset Telemetry to Normal (42°C)
REGISTER THE GATEWAY FIRST:
info: unlike devices, gateways are never auto-created. Before these heartbeats show up as ONLINE, create a gateway named exactly 'Virtual_Gateway_NodeRED' via the app's Gateways tab (Administrator or Shopfloor_Manager). Otherwise NBIRTH/NDATA is logged as an unregistered edge node and dropped.
